0.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTBREAKTERMINAL_00457_SYSTEM_000_001
0.description: Though the relay bears no visible signs of damage, it does not appear to be functioning at the moment...

1.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTBREAKTERMINAL_00457_KRILE_000_002
1.description: (-Krile-)This is Krile. Call it an educated guess, but I thought you might have arrived at Aethernet Control by now. If so, how does it look?

2.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTBREAKTERMINAL_00457_KRILE_000_003
2.description: (-Krile-)...Well, at least it wasn't smashed to pieces. If your assessment is correct, we may be able to reintegrate it into the Aethernet.

3.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTBREAKTERMINAL_00457_KRILE_000_004
3.description: (-Krile-)This may not sound like the most elegant solution, but sixty percent of the time it works every time. Right─we're going to flood the relay with a massive amount of aether to “wake” it up, as it were.

4.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTBREAKTERMINAL_00457_KRILE_000_005
4.description: (-Krile-)To that end, we're going to need to amass a substantial quantity of Anemos crystals. Ninety-nine crystals, assuming my calculations are correct.

5.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTBREAKTERMINAL_00457_KRILE_000_006
5.description: (-Krile-)I know it's a lot to ask, but I believe this is our best bet. Once you have them, bring them to Aethernet Control and I'll walk you through the process.

6.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTBREAKTERMINAL_00457_SYSTEM_100_010
6.description: To flood the Aethernet relay and continue the Eureka expedition, you will need to procure ninety-nine Anemos crystals. Please note that these crystals will be consumed in the process.

7.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTBREAKTERMINAL_00457_SYSTEM_100_011
7.description: Use the ninety-nine Anemos crystals to flood the relay with aether?

9.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTBREAKTERMINAL_00457_KRILE_000_011
9.description: (-Krile-)Rechecking measurements... Right. Listen carefully. To flood the relay with aether, we will need to repurpose your magia board as an elemental converter...

10.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTBREAKTERMINAL_00457_EUREKAPERSON_000_100
10.description: Seekest thou...power? Power to smite thine enemies?<hex:02100103>To cast down the wicked and raise up the righteous?

14.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTBREAKTERMINAL_00457_EUREKAPERSON_000_110
14.description: A warrior, then! Coveter of strength!<hex:02100103>Blessed art thou, arbiter of vengeance!

15.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTBREAKTERMINAL_00457_EUREKAPERSON_000_120
15.description: Art thou a pawn, then!? Content to surrender to the whim of fate─<hex:02100103>to bid welcome to the wicked and the dark!?

16.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTBREAKTERMINAL_00457_EUREKAPERSON_000_130
16.description: And within...within... A light burning, radiant, resplendent!

17.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTBREAKTERMINAL_00457_EUREKAPERSON_000_131
17.description: Lo, in light <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> walketh...and in light <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> abideth. Thus will I remember thee.

19.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTBREAKTERMINAL_00457_EUREKAYOUNGZ_000_201
19.description: Aye. Even if we fought the damned thing to our dying breaths, it'd endure. It's as though it has a nigh-bottomless wellspring of aether to draw upon...

20.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTBREAKTERMINAL_00457_EUREKAYOUNGG_000_202
20.description: Until such time as a permanent solution is found, it shall be sealed away. If any among you yet harbor doubts, speak them now.

21.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTBREAKTERMINAL_00457_EUREKAYOUNGD_000_203
21.description: You'll hear none from me. Let's do it and be done with it.

22.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTBREAKTERMINAL_00457_EUREKAYOUNGZ_000_204
22.description: Right, then. The matter of what to do may have been resolved, but we've still the matter of where to do it.

23.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTBREAKTERMINAL_00457_EUREKAYOUNGK_000_205
23.description: Not in the colony. That much is plain. The location must be remote─far from prying eyes and covetous men.

24.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTBREAKTERMINAL_00457_EUREKAYOUNGD_000_206
24.description: Well, Galuf? This was your idea. Got any suggestions?

25.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTBREAKTERMINAL_00457_EUREKAYOUNGG_000_207
25.description: (-Galuf-)As a matter of fact, I do. An island not far from the motherland. Deserted. Dangerous. The perfect place to build a prison...

27.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTBREAKTERMINAL_00457_KRILE_000_022
27.description: (-Krile-)Worked, did it? Glad to hear it. Our readings suggested as much, but I wanted your confirmation before I performed the final test...

28.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTBREAKTERMINAL_00457_KRILE_000_023
28.description: Well! I appear to have arrived with all my bits intact. I believe that constitutes a success. Very good. I'll have to perform various adjustments and measurements before we can risk teleportation to other regions, but this is nevertheless a significant accomplishment.

29.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTBREAKTERMINAL_00457_KRILE_000_024
29.description: By the way, you took an awfully long time to respond after initiating the process. Did something happen?

30.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTBREAKTERMINAL_00457_KRILE_000_025
30.description: Galuf!? You're certain that's the name you heard spoken in the vision?

31.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTBREAKTERMINAL_00457_KRILE_000_026
31.description: Four men, one of them a Lupin. And this masked man you met. If they were Grandfather's... Then would that make him...

32.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTBREAKTERMINAL_00457_KRILE_000_027
32.description: Ah, forgive me. Neither the time nor the place. Let us return to Port Surgate.

33.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTBREAKTERMINAL_00457_SYSTEM_000_030
33.description: Though the Aethernet relay appears to be fully operational at a glance, you recall Krile saying that it would require further adjustments before travel to other regions would be possible...

34.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTBREAKTERMINAL_00457_SYSTEM_000_040
34.description: The Aethernet relay appears to be functioning somewhat more efficiently than before, likely due to Krile's adjustments. Travel to other regions should no longer pose significant risk.

35.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA1EVENTBREAKTERMINAL_00457_SYSTEM_000_041
35.description: To continue the expedition elsewhere, you must depart <hex:02281CFF17436F6E74656E7446696E646572436F6E646974696F6EE8022C03> and speak with Rodney at Pier #1 in Kugane.
